title: Hello World
description: Basic HTML displaying a styled message.
css: .box { padding: 20px; background: #eef; font-size: 24px; border-radius: 8px; text-align: center; }

title: Button Click Message
description: Click the button to change message text.
css: button { padding: 10px 18px; background: #667eea; color: #fff; border-radius: 6px; border: none; cursor: pointer; }

title: Live Counter
css: .counter { font-size: 48px; text-align: center; font-weight: bold; padding: 20px; }

title: CSS Bouncing Ball
description: Simple bouncing animation using CSS keyframes.
css:
.ball { width: 40px; height: 40px; background: orange; border-radius: 50%; animation: bounce 1s infinite alternate; }
@keyframes bounce { from { transform: translateY(0); } to { transform: translateY(150px); } }

title: Live Input Mirror
css: input { padding: 10px; width: 250px; } p { font-size: 22px; color: #333; }

title: Light/Dark Theme Toggle
description: Simple theme toggle using CSS classes.

title: Responsive Grid Layout
description: Auto-fit CSS grid that adapts to screen size.
css:
.grid { display: grid; gap: 10px; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(120px, 1fr)); }
.grid div { background:#ddd; padding:20px; font-size:20px; text-align:center; border-radius:6px; }

title: Fade-In Animation
css:
.fade { opacity: 0; animation: fadeIn 2s forwards; font-size: 32px; }
@keyframes fadeIn { to { opacity: 1; } }

title: Accordion Toggle
css: .panel { max-height: 0; overflow: hidden; transition: max-height 0.3s; background:#eee; padding:0 10px; } .acc { padding:10px; cursor:pointer; }
js: document.querySelector('.acc').onclick = () => { const p = document.querySelector('.panel'); p.style.maxHeight = p.style.maxHeight ? '' : '100px'; };

title: Random Background Color
description: Click to change page color randomly.
css: button { padding:12px; cursor:pointer; }

title: Digital Clock
css: .clock { font-size:40px; text-align:center; margin-top:20px; }

title: Typing Text Effect
css: #type { font-size: 28px; border-right: 2px solid black; width: fit-content; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; }
js: const text = 'Typing animation effect'; let i=0; setInterval(()=>{ document.getElementById('type').textContent = text.slice(0,i++); }, 100);

title: Canvas Draw Dots
description: Click to draw dots on canvas.

title: Follow Mouse Circle
css: #circle { width:20px; height:20px; background:red; border-radius:50%; position:fixed; pointer-events:none; transition:transform 0.1s; }

title: Simple Modal Window
css:
.modal { display:none; position:fixed; inset:0; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.5); justify-content:center; align-items:center; }
.modal .content { background:white; padding:20px; border-radius:8px; font-size:22px; }

title: Hover Zoom Card
css:
.card { width:200px; height:120px; background:#ddd; display:flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; transition:transform 0.3s; }
.card:hover { transform:scale(1.1); }

title: Tab Switcher
html:
Content A
Content B
css: button { margin-right:5px; }

title: Draggable Box
description: Drag a box around the screen.
css: #box { width:100px; height:100px; background:#88e; color:white; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; cursor:grab; position:absolute; }

title: Input Slider Preview
html: Resize me
css: p { transition: font-size 0.2s; }

title: Animated Rainbow Text
css: h1 { transition: color 0.4s; font-size:48px; }

title: Animated Progress Bar
css: .bar { width:100%; max-width:300px; height:20px; background:#ccc; } #fill { height:100%; width:0; background:#4c8; transition:width 0.2s; }

title: Photo Gallery Layout
css:
.gallery { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(120px,1fr)); gap:8px; }
.gallery div { background:#ddd; height:120px; border-radius:6px; }
